question.text: A decapeptide (molecular weight 796) on complete hydrolysis gives glycine (molecular weight 75), alanine and phenylalanine. Glycine contributes $47.0 \%$ to the total weight of the hydrolysed products. The number of glycine units present in the decapeptide is
